load_adapter_weights: load a PEFT adapter from a Hub repository or local path and inject it into a transformer model
enable_peft_hotswap: enable hotswapping of LoRA adapters with different ranks or compiled models without recompilation
set_active_adapter: set a specific PEFT adapter as active and disable all other adapters on the model
add_adapter_to_model: add a new PEFT adapter configuration to a transformer model for training
convert_peft_config: convert a PEFT LoRA config for transformers v5 architecture changes on MoE models like Mixtral
